patch_description:
Restore the structured parameter approach from the best-performing program (score 0.58) and duplicate the Ising entangler block to deepen the circuit and enhance correlation capture for hard samples.

Key changes:
1. Add individual parameter names for each Ising gate pair (xx_01, xx_67, yy_23, yy_14, zz_45, zz_36) instead of sharing across all gates
2. Restore the pre-processing RZ layer (rz_pre) applied to all qubits before entanglement
3. Duplicate the Ising entangler block immediately after the first sequence but before the post-processing RZ layer
4. Reuse the same parameter names in the duplicated block (parameter sharing across the two repetitions, not changing n_distinct_params)
5. Restore post-processing RZ layer (rz_post) after all entanglement

This maintains n_distinct_params=10 while achieving ~depth 30, leveraging the "sweet-spot" depth that drove the best program's success. The duplication intensifies qubit correlations to better separate hard samples (improving worst_group_margin), addressing the current program's weakness where worst_group_margin is only 0.25.
